description: This file defines an internal interface 'IMessageStatisticsSink' and a sealed class 'NoOpMessageStatisticsSink' related to message statistics handling within the Orleans core placement repartitioning framework.

classes.name: IMessageStatisticsSink
classes.description: Internal interface for message statistics sink, providing a method to obtain a message observer/action.

classes.name: NoOpMessageStatisticsSink
classes.description: Sealed class implementing IMessageStatisticsSink that performs no operation, returning null for the message observer.

methods.name: GetMessageObserver
methods.description: Returns an optional Action<Message> observer; in NoOpMessageStatisticsSink, it returns null.
